name: portable-execution-contract
description: Enforce and grade the harness-neutral SL8 run contract after a tuple and agent bundle are selected. Use for RunSpec construction, normalized event/state handling, evidence-packet validation, reconnect or cancellation truth, lifecycle receipts, multi-agent bounds, legacy output compatibility, or named portable QC failures. Do not choose a harness/model or assemble the bundle here; use harness-selection and portable-agent-bundle first.
